# CREW 360 & MyStaffTravel

> Modern airline crew performance management and employee staff travel platform.

CREW 360 provides software solutions designed for modern aviation operations, connecting cabin crew, supervisors, and airline leadership with real-time insights, flight evaluations, and automated staff travel privileges.

## Product Solutions
- [Crew 360](https://www.crew360.ai/product/crew-360): Real-time flight evaluations, performance analytics, and cabin crew management.
- [MyStaffTravel](https://www.crew360.ai/product/staff-travel): Configurable airline employee staff travel portal, approval workflows, and eligibility tracking.
